T: Jet lagged, wide awake, and hungry.
D: A fading actor and a young woman, both stuck awake in a Tokyo hotel, form an unlikely bond.
P: Serve the mains when Bob and Charlotte sit down to cook their own shabu-shabu.
S: the bar high above Tokyo where they meet
Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed with flaky salt and sesame oil, and rice crackers with wasabi peas in little lacquer bowls.
the karaoke night in the private room
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in soy, sake, ginger and garlic for an hour, coated in potato starch, fried at 160C, rested, fried again at 190C. Japanese mayo and lemon.

Warm seasoned short grain rice pressed into triangles around tuna mayo or flaked salted salmon, wrapped in crisp nori just before eating. Wash 400g short grain rice until clear and cook with 480ml water. Season with salt and cool until just warm. Mix a 185g tin of tuna with 3 tbsp Japanese mayo and a little soy. Salt a 200g salmon fillet, grill 8 minutes and flake. With wet, salted hands shape 8 triangles, pushing a spoon of filling into the middle of each. Wrap with nori strips just before eating.
M: the restaurant where Bob complains you have to cook it yourself
Kombu simmered in water for a broth at the table, paper-thin beef, tofu, wombok, enoki and spring onion swished through, dipped in ponzu and sesame sauce. Rice to finish.
Kyoto kitsune udon with soft egg
Charlotte's day trip to the temples

Thick udon in a dashi of kombu and bonito with soy and mirin, topped with sweet simmered tofu, a soft egg, spring onion and tempura flakes. Soak a 10cm piece of kombu in 1.6L water for 30 minutes, bring to a simmer, remove and add 20g bonito flakes. Steep 5 minutes and strain, then season with 4 tbsp soy and 3 tbsp mirin. Simmer 4 fried tofu pouches in 200ml of the broth with 1 tbsp sugar for 10 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes. Cook 800g fresh udon for 2 minutes, divide into bowls and top with broth, tofu, halved eggs, spring onion and tempura flakes.
W: Matcha whisked into sweetened condensed milk and cream, whipped to soft peaks, frozen 6 hours, scooped soft into cones.
K: the drink Bob is in Tokyo to sell
45ml Japanese whisky in a tall glass packed with ice, topped with very cold soda water, stirred once, a twist of lemon.

s.note: the bar high above Tokyo where they meet
s.how: Steam 400g edamame for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt and a little sesame oil. Serve in small bowls with rice crackers and 100g wasabi peas.

s.note: the karaoke night in the private room
s.how: Marinate 700g chicken thigh pieces for an hour in 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sake, grated ginger and garlic. Coat in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C, rest, then fry again at 190C until crisp. Serve with mayo and lemon.

m.note: the restaurant where Bob complains you have to cook it yourself
m.how: Soak a piece of kombu in 2L water for 30 minutes and bring to a simmer at the table. Swish 600g thin sliced beef, 300g tofu, a quarter wombok, 100g enoki and spring onion through the broth. Dip in ponzu. Finish with rice.

w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into a 395g tin of condensed milk. Whip 400ml cream to soft peaks and fold through. Freeze 6 hours, then scoop soft into 4 waffle cones.

d.note: the drink Bob is in Tokyo to sell
d.how: For each drink, pack a tall glass with ice. Add 45ml Japanese whisky and top with very cold soda water. Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.
